title: SUI project registry
description: The list of every project registered with the Valley Christian Startup Incubator.

slug.description: URL-safe id, lowercase with dashes. Must be unique across the registry.

tagline.description: One short sentence describing what the project does.

repo.description: GitHub repo as owner/name. Usually YOUR account (you keep owning your code). Only point this at Valley-Christian-Startup-Incubator/... after you transfer the project to the org at hand-off.

status.description: active = you still own/run it; seeking-steward = looking for someone to take it over; archived = no longer maintained.

stack.description: Optional list of key technologies, e.g. ["Next.js", "Supabase"].

owners.description: GitHub handles of the people who own/maintain the project.

handoffDocs.description: Optional path or URL to the maintain/deploy/learn docs, e.g. "README.md".

addedAt.description: Date the project was registered, YYYY-MM-DD.
